entities.name: Prudencio Cardona
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Prudencio Cardona was a Colombian professional boxer who was world flyweight champion. He represented his native country at the 1972 Summer Olympics in Munich, West Germany. He was the older brother of former super bantamweight world champion, Ricardo Cardona.
